lessons.lesson: Roshan's motion direction was written as acting and process, without a picture of the motion (views, fin side, drawings per stroke, follow-through, blur policy); every owner verdict on Grok and local takes named one of those missing specifications.

Atlas rows generated as four keyframes are pose keys, not motion; each runtime player hid the gaps differently (cross-fade, 4-8 fps loops, equal-time slideshows, sliding still cutouts), and each trick failed a different motion rule. Measure neighbouring-frame change before playing a row as a loop.
Returned external takes and owner decisions left on unmerged branches were never reviewed or registered; search remote branches before commissioning new generation.

strengths_observed.evidence: The 2026-09-11 movement language anticipated the owner's later verdicts (tail-driven travel, no mirrored paddling, quiet idle); this analysis keeps it as the acting layer and adds a visual motion layer.
The Grand Puff identity lock and clip contract format are reused as the model for Roshan's home poses and per-clip contracts (RM1).
